name: airplay-mcp
description: Turns your computer into an AirPlay receiver so Claude can see your mirrored iPhone or iPad screen. Runs locally: needs Claude Code or Claude Desktop on the same Wi-Fi as the phone. Run /airplay-mcp:setup first.

receiver.title: Receiver
receiver.description: Type native (built-in receiver, needs the FairPlay folder below) or uxplay (the UxPlay program). /airplay-mcp:setup helps you pick and install.

fp_emu_dir.title: FairPlay folder (native only)
fp_emu_dir.description: Folder holding the four files extracted from your own iPhone firmware. Leave blank for uxplay.

uxplay_path.title: UxPlay executable (uxplay only)
uxplay_path.description: Full path to uxplay if it is not on PATH (usual on Windows). Leave blank otherwise.

device_name.title: AirPlay name
device_name.description: Name your phone shows under Screen Mirroring.
